signs.text: The assay-scales, under a cloth. Nobody has lifted it in seventy years; the dust on it is even.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 A (the tollhouse)

signs.text: THE TARIFF. Ingots by the stamp, lead by the pig, litharge by the jar. Charcoal, timber, salt, tallow, rope and bone-ash down. The prices are in a coin with a king's face nobody uses now.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 (trade goods: up and down; INFERENCE, PROPOSED)

signs.text: Brick, and a red mark cut across it. The old cut a shaft crew broke into, sixty years ago. The water went bad through here, and then the town burned.
signs.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the Water Burning: an old dwarven cut feeding a cistern); spec §4.3 A

signs.text: The stamp-mill wheel. The ore it broke is long gone; it turns because the covenant says the town's fountains must run, and the wheel is what meters them.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 A (the falls-works)

signs.text: The high seat of the Silversands, on its dais. Empty. He stands at the door.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the clan hall); spine-recut §5 (the throne on a dais at the hall's north end)

signs.text: The oath-stone of the Silversands, directly below the empty seat. Every one of them put a hand here once; the band of gold is worn bright at hand height. At noon the light lands here.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B; spine-recut §5 (the beam lands on the oath-stone; "At noon the light lands here." seat's draft)

signs.text: The hero-wall: the highway's dead, names cut in rows. Where a row stops short, a family stopped.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the hero-wall; a family's row ending is what "wiped out" looks like on stone)

signs.text: The Forge-Father's niche: an anvil, worn to a saddle in the middle.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (the Dwarven Triad: Motsognir, the Forge-Father); spec §4.3 B

signs.text: Rekknar's ledger-stone. Every line on it balances.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (Rekknar the Reckoner); spec §4.3 B

signs.text: A plain cut in the rock with nothing in it. The Dormant's.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (Dvalgarda, the vigil); spec §4.3 B (the sect is never named here)

signs.text: The smokehouse: meat, and nothing else. The rest of the table comes from the grow and the dark.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the kitchens); spine-recut §5 (Solskaft feeds itself; the food-from-below line cut)

signs.text: The brewhouse. Dwarves. The hops come down from the terrace in baskets.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B; spine-recut §5 (hops for the brewhouse, PROPOSED by the east-Washington rule)

signs.text: Six tiers of bunks up here, and a season's troops fill two of them. Dust on the rest.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §4.3 B (the barracks tiers, most of them dark)

signs.text: GREYSEAM, cut in the lintel. Barred from outside since the clans went back deep. The dust on the step is even.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (the residential quarter, the familial residences, CLOSED: CANON 09-26d; the family names are the Burial's lines and the garrison's clans; the smiths' hedge, seat's call)

signs.src: spine-recut §5 (the residential quarter, the familial residences, CLOSED: CANON 09-26d; the family names are the Burial's lines and the garrison's clans; the smiths' hedge, seat's call)

signs.text: GEIRMUND, cut in the lintel. Barred. The line that lived here ended on the road; the ledger has the house.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (the residential quarter, the familial residences, CLOSED: CANON 09-26d; the family names are the Burial's lines and the garrison's clans; the smiths' hedge, seat's call)

signs.text: SCALEBEAM, cut in the lintel, and the one door on the street with a light behind it.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (one lit door: the Scalebeam house, CANON 09-26e)

signs.text: Apple trees, in soil carried up in baskets a season at a time. The fruit is small and very sweet.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (the grow is an apple orchard: RULED 09-26d)

signs.text: Cherries, trained flat to the rock where the light is longest.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (cherries and pears, PROPOSED by his climate rule)

signs.text: Pear trees, the oldest things growing in Solskaft.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (PROPOSED by his climate rule)

signs.text: A mint bed. It gets into everything, the gardener says, which is the point.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (a mint bed, PROPOSED)

signs.text: Dry-land wheat, thin and gold, along the terrace's long edge. It barely needs watering, which is why it is here.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (dry-land wheat, PROPOSED by the east-Washington rule)

signs.text: The shroom farm: beds of spent ore-dust and dung in the dark, the caps pale in a hooded lamp. This is what Solskaft actually eats.
signs.src: wiki/solskaft.md (the shroom farms, CANON 09-26c); spine-recut §5 (the shrooms are the staple)
